description: This file implements configuration parsing and management functions for OpenSSL, including loading configuration files, handling sections and key-value pairs, variable expansion, and comment processing.

methods.name: NCONF_free
methods.description: Frees a configuration object and its associated data.

methods.name: NCONF_get_section
methods.description: Retrieves a section as a stack of key-value pairs.

methods.name: NCONF_get_string
methods.description: Retrieves a string value for a given section and key.

methods.name: NCONF_load_bio
methods.description: Loads configuration from a BIO stream.

methods.name: CONF_parse_list
methods.description: Parses a list of elements separated by a delimiter.

methods.name: CONF_modules_load_file
methods.description: Loads configuration modules from a file (stub implementation).

methods.name: OPENSSL_config
methods.description: Configures OpenSSL using a specified configuration name (stub).
